presentation.label: Back pain
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us about your back pain and when it started.

questions.question: Was the pain caused by an injury or accident?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the back pain was caused by an injury or accident?

questions.question: Have you noticed any weakness in your legs?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has noticed weakness in their legs?

questions.question: Have you noticed any numbness or loss of sensation in your legs?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has noticed numbness or loss of sensation in their legs?

questions.question: Have you had any incontinence of the bladder or bowels?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has had any incontinence of the bladder or bowels?

questions.question: Have you been diagnosed with cancer?
questions.encoder_prompt: Does the response indicate that the patient has been diagnosed with cancer?

questions.question: How long have these symptoms been going on for?
